name: calendar
need: Show a month and let someone pick a day or a range in it, in the page's locale

--ds-calendar-cell.description: a day of the calendar at size md and the comfortable density: 8px per size step, 4px per density step on top

--ds-calendar-today.description: the ring and ink of today

--ds-calendar-selected-bg.description: the fill of the chosen day and of the ends of a range

--ds-calendar-range-bg.description: the band of a range (its preview mixes it at `--ds-state-pressed`)
